note: A workbench created under JSON control: migration is null (spec 4.1).
The spec 4.1 example verbatim: a completed import with its receipt under archive/migrations/.
A second required feature and a non-empty extensions block are admitted as long as json-control-v1 is present.
An unknown key outside extensions is a schema error (spec 4).
id must be a lowercase RFC 4122 UUID.
An uppercase UUID is refused by the lowercase pattern.
required_features must contain json-control-v1.
required_features needs at least one entry.
required_features is a set; an identical repeated entry is refused.
A feature name is a lowercase token.
Every key is required; migration may be null but not absent.
migration.id follows migration-YYYYMMDD-<slug>.
source_layout is fusion-v12 or fusion-pre-v12.
The receipt must live under archive/migrations/<migration.id>/.
A workbench path never starts with a slash.
The migration block admits no unknown key either.
extensions is an object, never a list.
A record whose schema field names another known contract fails the const when validated as a workbench manifest.
A schema field naming an unknown namespace is refused as unsupported-format, not as a schema error.
The spec 4.2 example verbatim: an open package with no claim, no documents and no outcome.
claimed with a full claim (checkout_id, person, claimed_at) and one active plan.
paused carries no claim; origin package names the package whose scope it decomposes; one terminal depends_on edge.
done with class completed, the historical claim kept, and one accepted prior-enforced evidence binding, which is what a succeeded dependency requires.
done with class legacy-completed requires provenance.source legacy-terminal with a backup; domain null and a raw legacy mode line are admitted on an imported record.
dropped with class failed and a non-empty reason; the claim was released before the package was dropped.
dropped with class cancelled keeps a historical claim whose person and time are unknown (null), and origin campaign carries its ref.
Two specs and one plan in active_documents: any number of specs, at most one plan.
mode autonomous sourced by the user's word held in an artefact; the source is never null on autonomous.

Exercises fusion.common/v1's record_ref, artefact_ref, foreign_ref and all three legacy citation strings through references, plus both depends_on conditions and provenance imported with a backup; common exposes no record-level schema, so no fixture lives under common/.
An unknown key outside extensions is a schema error.
status claimed requires a non-null claim.
status open requires claim null.
status paused requires claim null.
A terminal status carries an outcome object, not null.
done admits completed and legacy-completed only.
dropped admits bounded, cancelled, failed and dropped only.
outcome is null while the package is open.
At most one active_documents entry has role plan.
A depends_on condition is terminal or succeeded (contract/dependencies.json).
A revision is sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.
An artefact path may not contain a .. segment.
An artefact path is workbench-relative; an absolute user path is refused.
depends_on is a set; an identical repeated edge is refused (distinct record_ids with different display are left to transitions.ts).
id must be a lowercase RFC 4122 UUID, not a basename.
mode autonomous requires a non-null source; an agent never invents consent.
Class legacy-completed requires provenance.source legacy-terminal.
provenance legacy-terminal requires a terminal status.
provenance imported requires a backup artefact reference.
origin package requires a record ref.
origin legacy-unknown carries no ref.
A non-completed outcome class carries a non-empty reason.
status is one of the five conventions values; no further lifecycle taxonomy.
Every key is required; an empty list is written as [], never omitted.
checkout_id is eight lowercase hex characters.
A timestamp is RFC 3339 with an offset; a value without one is refused, never guessed.
An evidence binding pins an exact revision.
execution_policy is claude-guided or prior-enforced.
The narrative path names a Markdown file.
domain is code, data or null.
mode.value is ordinary or autonomous.
The schema field must equal fusion.package/v1 when validated as a package.
An unknown person is null, not the empty string.
references is a set; an identical repeated citation is refused.
A foreign citation needs both literal segments and a valid basename.
extensions is an object; null is not an empty extensions block.
An open issue: disposition null, no candidate block.
A closed issue carries a disposition object whose reason_ref is a legacy citation; the terminal Markdown stays byte-identical under provenance legacy-terminal.
An in-progress issue with the full candidate block: a passed qualification, an admitted selection and its admission, every field of Prior's Candidate typed exactly.
A merged candidate: merge_into and outcome merged imply each other, and a merged selection carries neither policy version nor snapshot hash.
Unobserved qualification, selection and admission are null, not negative results.
Legacy signed values transported as stored: severity -1, estimated_scope -2 and a selection score of -3 are admitted (Prior's FJ00 response 2); confidence and risk stay non-negative.
Evidence keeps order and multiplicity: one entry whose ref and revision are null (an empty Prior string), and two identical entries; the qualification over it is recorded as failed, never promoted.
An adopted plan in progress: step anchors in each of the three step states, one evaluated and one unevaluated criterion, acceptance bound to the adopting package at an exact revision.
An unadopted plan: acceptance null, criteria empty.
An open discussion with two participants and no outcome yet; open is read as interrupted, and the state enum is open or closed.
A closed discussion whose outcomes are a record ref and a legacy marker citation; closed is the one terminal state and open to closed the only edge.
An open decision carries no answer, implementation or successor.
answered cites the answer (here an artefact ref) and nothing else.
implemented cites the implementation as a git commit.
superseded names its successor; the historical answer and full-length implementation commit stay.
deferred carries a deferral naming an external target (v1.x, never a manufactured record id) and who ruled, and neither implementation nor successor (Prior's FJ00 response 5c).
A decision control inside an issue record matches no branch of the kind union.
An issue control forbids the plan kind's fields.
kind plan with an issue control fails the discriminated union.
kind is one of issue, plan, discussion, decision.
An unknown key outside extensions is a schema error.
An open issue has disposition null.
A closed issue carries a disposition object.
An issue state is open, in_progress, closed or deferred.
The disposition kind is a lowercase token.

The disposition kind is one of fixed, duplicate, deferred, rejected, out-of-scope, merged, superseded (Prior's FJ00 response 6a, decision 260928-1420_*_which-closed-vocabularies-do-artefact-kind-and-issue-disposition-kind-take.md); resolved, a well-formed token outside the set, is refused, so the closure itself is pinned and not only the token rule.
risk stays a non-negative integer, as does confidence: the two bounds Prior validates at intake; severity, estimated_scope and score are signed.
A boolean check result is not a status string.
A version counter is a positive integer.
An admitted selection carries an admission.
An admission needs a qualification; the contradiction is refused, not healed.
merge_into requires the selection outcome merged.
A merged selection carries no policy version.
Outcome merged requires a merge target.
affected_resources is a set.
refresh_policy is snapshot, checkpoint or continuous.
A Prior source revision carries the prior-opaque: prefix, never a bare string.
Prior's evidenceHash is a prior-json-sha256: value, not a fusion sha256.
The selection outcome vocabulary is Prior's at 12d8424.
checked_at is RFC 3339 with an offset.
Statement and Purpose are prose and live in the narrative, not in the candidate block.
A step state is open, in_progress or done.
steps is a set; an identical repeated anchor is refused.
met is true, false or null, never a string.
An acceptance binds the exact plan revision adopted.
An open decision carries no answer.
answered requires an answer reference.
answered carries no implementation yet.
implemented requires an implementation reference.
An implementation reference is a git object name or a reference, not free text.
superseded names its successor.
deferred carries no successor.
deferred requires a deferral object naming the target and who ruled; a missing legacy target or ruler is a migration finding, never a null.
Every state but deferred requires deferral null.
A decision state is open, answered, implemented, superseded or deferred; dropped, the word the draft spec used for _d_, is outside the enum.
An actor name is a lowercase token.
A legacy marker citation admits only the conventions' marker letters.
A discussion state is open or closed (Prior's FJ00 response 5b); in_progress and deferred are outside the enum, and a legacy record carrying one is a migration finding.
A foreign_ref project name contains no colon, slash or whitespace.
control is required.
A drafted campaign that never used a register or a formation: both null, every nullable state field null.
A running campaign with a closed register (policy and snapshot persisted) and a formation holding completed, failed and formed packages, a settled and an open admission.
archived requires previous_terminal; the completion evidence handed to Finalize is kept.

Prior's FJ00 response 2 transported as stored: a formation candidate with risk -1, a stale package carrying a failure_reason, and a charter whose item_kinds and data_boundary each repeat an entry (order and multiplicity enter CharterHash).
An unknown key outside extensions is a schema error.
archived requires a previous terminal state.
Only archived carries a previous terminal state.
The campaign state vocabulary is campaign.go's at 12d8424.
requested_outcome is bounded, failed, cancelled or null; completed is never requested.
A closed intake names its closing watermark.
max_attempts is a positive integer, as Charter.Validate enforces.
A charter names at least one item kind.
charter_hash is Prior's hash and carries prior-json-sha256:, never a fusion sha256.
An empty Prior string imports as null, never as a bare prior-opaque: prefix.
A failed formation package carries a failure reason.
A formed package has no accepted revision yet.
A formation package state is Prior's vocabulary; fusion's status words are not applied here.
stable is a keyed set; an identical repeated entry is refused.
A predicate field is one of the four rating names.
Admission status values are those packages.go writes.
An attempt counter is a positive integer.
A snapshot version is a positive integer.
An unknown watermark is null, not the empty string.
Counters are non-negative integers.
workbench_id is required.
An accepted prior-enforced review over a git range; the binding a succeeded dependency needs.
A claude-guided review with verdict revise over a tree without a range and without a plan; every check result value appears.
A correction names its predecessor at an exact revision; a SHA-256 git tree name is admitted beside SHA-1.
An unknown key outside extensions is a schema error.
The verdict vocabulary is accept, revise, escalate.
execution_policy is claude-guided or prior-enforced.
host is claude-code or prior.
The subject tree is a full object name, never abbreviated.
A range is two object names, not ref names.
A check result is pass, fail, skipped or unknown.
An absent detail is null, not the empty string.
checks is a set; an identical repeated check is refused.
A hash is algorithm-qualified; bare hex is refused.
The report path may not traverse out of the workbench.
The artefact kind is a lowercase token.

The artefact kind is one of the twenty closed tokens (Prior's FJ00 response 6a, decision 260928-1420_*_which-closed-vocabularies-do-artefact-kind-and-issue-disposition-kind-take.md); markdown, a well-formed token outside the set, is refused: a kind names what an artefact is, never its file format, and an evidence report is report.
accepted_at is RFC 3339 with an offset.
brief_revision is never null; only plan_revision may be.
predecessor is a record ref or null, never a citation string.
The role profile is a lowercase token.
An uncertainty is a non-empty sentence.
A UTF-8 byte order mark before an otherwise valid workbench manifest is refused.
A key repeated inside a nested object (migration.id) is refused; JSON.parse alone would keep the last value.
NaN is not a JSON number; the refusal names it rather than leaving it to a syntax error.
Exactly one top-level value is admitted.
A control record is an object; a top-level array is refused even when its element is valid.
A trailing comma is outside the scanner's model and is reported as syntax with JSON.parse's message.
A lone 0xFF byte inside a string is not well-formed UTF-8.
A valid package record padded inside extensions to exactly 1 048 577 bytes, one over the 1 MiB cap.
CRLF line endings are whitespace to a reader and the manifest validates; a writer never produces CRLF, it emits LF with a final newline.
inspect takes the workbench root and nothing else.
list over one store; scope is a workbench-relative path.
show names one pair by the workbench-relative path of its control file.
validate without a record checks the whole workbench; workbench left out, so main.ts takes FUSION_WORKBENCH.
create with a pre-assigned id, the filer, the origin and the scope (spec section 6 row create).
transition open to claimed with the claim the target state requires.
claim as its own operation (spec section 6).
release with a reason.
set-mode with a user-word source.
set-dependencies with one succeeded edge.
adopt-plan binds the plan record at the accepted narrative hash.
attach-evidence with a revision-pinned evidence_ref.
reconcile over the whole workbench.
migration survey needs no plan; migration lands in FJ04.
create of a package carrying its Markdown body in narrative.content, so one request writes both halves of the pair; content is optional and create.json, without it, still validates.
transition of a decision to deferred with payload.deferral naming an external target and who ruled, the one definition record.schema.json holds at $defs/deferral.
transition of a decision to answered whose answer_ref is a legacy citation string: the payload admits any reference, as decision_control does, not only a record_ref.
adopt-plan with role spec binds a spec record; role is optional and absent means plan.
The record selector admits an evidence record's file, <name>.evidence.json, beside package.json and <name>.record.json.
transition of a plan carrying payload.steps and payload.criteria, updates keyed by id in the shapes record.schema.json holds at $defs/plan_step and $defs/plan_criterion (Prior's FJ02 response 18).
create of kind evidence, its own branch: scope names the reviews store and payload is the complete fusion.evidence/v1 record, here a first record with predecessor null (Prior's FJ02 response 19).
create of kind evidence for a correction: the payload's predecessor is a revision-pinned record_ref over the same report.
An unknown key on any branch is refused: every branch is additionalProperties false.
scope is workbench-relative; a leading slash is refused.
A record is named by its control file, package.json or <name>.record.json, never by the narrative.
workbench is an absolute path.
Every mutation carries an operation_id.
expected_revision is an algorithm-qualified sha256: value.
checkout_id is eight lowercase hex characters.
release needs a non-empty reason.
mode.value is ordinary or autonomous.
A depends_on condition is terminal or succeeded (codec/contract/dependencies.json).
adopt-plan binds a revision; without one there is nothing to bind.
An evidence_ref is pinned to an exact revision.
reconcile is a read and carries no operation_id.
The migration phases are survey, plan, apply and verify.
An op outside the fourteen of spec section 6 matches no branch. The dispatcher answers operation-unknown before validation; the schema alone says schema-invalid.
op is required.
narrative.content is the Markdown body as one string; a list of lines is refused.
adopt-plan's role is spec or plan.
A deferral names its target and who ruled; one without ruled_by is refused.
A step's state in the payload is open, in_progress or done, as $defs/plan_step holds it; blocked is refused.
A criterion's met in the payload is true, false or null, as $defs/plan_criterion holds it; a string is refused.
create of kind evidence requires scope.
The payload of create of kind evidence is a complete fusion.evidence/v1 record; one without report is refused.
create of kind evidence carrying narrative matches neither create branch: the evidence branch does not admit narrative and the record branch's kind has no evidence.
